overview: Realistic or semi-realistic ice/crystal materials should read as a darker shell around a colder, brighter core with crack/specular breakup doing more work than emissive.
common_failure_modes: flat shell with no specular breakup
cyan orb look with no shell/core separation
large shard texture reading as plastic instead of ice
capture_review_checklist: Front shot separates shell and core clearly.
Three-quarter shot shows crack/spec breakup instead of flat tint.
Grazing shot keeps edge readability without becoming neon.
